summary: Round 1 OpenSpec change add-operation-history written: 4 requirements, 3 intents fully mapped, strict validation passed.
checked_criteria: Every intent of the original request mapped to at least one requirement
Every requirement has a failure or boundary scenario where one exists

requirements.text: The history SHALL contain only operations owned by the authenticated user.
The user SHALL filter history by operation type and date range.
History SHALL be paginated and the filter and page SHALL survive a page reload via URL parameters.
With no matching operations the history SHALL show an empty state.

intent_map.intent: pagination works together with filter, also after reload

acceptance_criteria.observable: GET /api/history as user A returns only rows with owner A while user B has 5 operations.
Filter type=transfer returns only transfers; invalid type returns 400 with a field error.
With 45 transfers, page 2 with type=transfer shows items 21-40; after reload the same items and filter are shown.
A user with no operations sees the empty state text, not an error.
